title: Salomon Soft Flask 500ml/17oz 42 — product specifications
claims: The Soft Flask 500ml/17oz 42 holds 0.5 L and weighs 33 g per unit; listed body dimensions are 30 x 8.5 cm (L x W x D).
The flask shrinks as you drink to limit water bounce and show how much liquid remains; it uses a high-flow valve and a 42 mm opening for refilling, drinking on the move and adding ice.
Body composition is 55% thermoplastic polyurethane, 35% polyoxymethylene and 10% silicone; it is 100% BPA and PVC free, uses TPU with RF welded seams, and is PFC-free.
